# `^BM` – MSI Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Print an MSI barcode, a pulse-width modulated continuous non-self-checking symbology.

Reference parameters: **o, e, h, f, g, e2**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 122](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
